newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST - China July industrial output up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - China July industrial output up 12 pct.

text.p: China's industrial output is forecast to rise to 167.5 billion yuan ($20.18 billion) in July, up around 12 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the Securities Daily said on Tuesday.

The key factors affecting industrial production would remain largely unchanged in July, although seasonal factors would have an effect on output growth, it quoted a report by the Information Centre under the State Economic and Trade Commission as saying.
Seasonal factors included floods that would threaten normal output by some factories, it said.
July was also a peak period for electricity consumption and residents would be given priority over industries, it said but gave no details.
China's economy was going through a key period of structural adjustment, and improvements were becoming apparent in many areas, it said.
Industrial output rose 11.6 percent year-on-year in the first half of 1997, the State Statistical Bureau said this week.
